answer: Make new identities earn trust slowly, like a garden that only yields after seasons of tending. Each fresh agent starts with near-zero voting weight, and weight grows only from peer-graded work spread across many epochs. A sybil farm can spin up a thousand keys, but a cipher costs nothing while patience does; a raven watching the ledger would see those clones all idle, unvouched, and unable to sway a single ballot.
